name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes federated movies/episodes getting stuck loading (or silently failing to play at all) on every playback attempt, not just the first. 0.0.26 set IsShortcut/ShortcutPath on federated items to mark their media source IsRemote, believing it was the same mechanism .strm files use - it is not. Jellyfin's ProbeProvider.FetchShortcutInfo unconditionally does File.ReadAllLines(item.Path), expecting Path to point at a real local .strm file whose contents are the target URL; since our Path already *is* that URL, the read throws DirectoryNotFoundException on every metadata refresh. Because that failure prevents MediaStreams from ever being saved, the refresh (and the failure) re-fires on every subsequent playback attempt, and clients observe this as an endless loading spinner or a request that silently gives up. IsShortcut/ShortcutPath are no longer set; Path alone (an http(s) URL) already gives correct LocationType/Protocol without it, and the dynamic per-request media source (FederationMediaSourceProvider) already sets IsRemote independently and is unaffected by this bug.
